paths.description: Homepage and only discovered HTML surface; represents the entire empty site. Tested desktop, mobile, preference emulation, no-JS discoverability, network/security, and memory. Not covered: no article/listing/form/account/app archetypes exist; robots and sitemap expose no valid routes.
Deliberately nonexistent route used to inspect HTTP failure handling.

findings.summary: The public URL serves an entirely empty page, so there is no purpose, content, action, flow, or recovery state.
findings.evidence: DOM and evaluate probes show <head> and <body> empty, zero text, headings, links, controls, forms, scripts, and styles. Desktop/mobile screenshots are blank white. The response is HTTP 200 with Content-Length: 0.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve meaningful semantic HTML with a descriptive heading, concise purpose statement, primary action, and explicit loading/error/empty states. Ensure the main task is reachable end to end.

findings.summary: There is no theme implementation and the empty white canvas does not adapt to dark mode.
findings.evidence: Normal and prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots are pixel-equivalent blank white canvases; the DOM has no CSS, color-scheme declaration, or media rules.
findings.suggestedFix: After restoring content, declare color-scheme and use system-driven light/dark tokens or light-dark() so all surfaces and browser chrome adapt.

findings.summary: No navigation, location cue, or attention-guiding state exists.
findings.evidence: The rendered DOM has zero links, headings, controls, landmarks, or content; route recon found no sitemap entries and all tested paths return an empty response.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide semantic navigation and clear current-location/next-action cues; add transition or focus cues where navigation changes context.

findings.summary: The document omits the viewport meta tag, causing Chrome to render a 980 CSS-pixel layout viewport on a 360-pixel device.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout evidence reports hasViewportMeta:false and clientWidth/innerWidth 980 at a 360x800 emulated viewport; DOM contains no meta elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and build restored content with fluid/intrinsic layout.

findings.summary: The page never paints content, so load speed cannot produce a usable outcome and Lighthouse aborts with NO_FCP.
findings.evidence: Trace has no FCP or LCP and Lighthouse records runtimeError NO_FCP with all category scores null. This is caused by the empty document, not by a slow but usable render.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore meaningful initial HTML so FCP/LCP exist, then optimize the LCP resource and validate CWV under representative conditions.

findings.summary: The page has no semantic structure or perceivable content, and mobile scaling is not configured.
findings.evidence: DOM/evaluate evidence shows no headings, landmarks, links, controls, labels, images, or lang attribute; viewport meta is absent. A blank page offers no comparable experience to assistive-technology users.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore semantic landmarks and heading hierarchy, identify the document language, provide named controls and text alternatives, and permit responsive zoom/reflow.

findings.summary: The served document has neither a doctype nor a declared character encoding.
findings.evidence: Raw response body is zero bytes; the browser-normalized DOM is <html><head></head><body></body></html>; evaluate reports doctype:null and no meta tags.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a complete HTML document beginning with <!doctype html> and include <meta charset="utf-8"> near the start of <head>.

findings.summary: The page has no title, description, canonical URL, meaningful links, structured data, share metadata, or sitemap.
findings.evidence: Discoverability reports renderedEmpty:true, zero rendered/raw content tokens, empty title and no H1. DOM has no metadata or links. /sitemap.xml returns the literal text "empty OK" rather than XML.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a unique title and meta description, canonical and Open Graph metadata, crawlable descriptive links, and a valid sitemap representing real public pages.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but browser-enforced security headers are entirely absent.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence reports missing CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS and nosniff, deploy a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, and define explicit Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy values appropriate to the restored site.

findings.summary: Unknown routes return HTTP 200 with “empty OK” instead of an intentional 404 and recovery path.
findings.evidence: A deliberately nonexistent route returned 200 text/plain with body "empty OK"; /sitemap.xml does the same. This masks failures and gives users/crawlers misleading success states.
findings.suggestedFix: Return correct 404/410 status codes and a useful HTML error page with navigation back to valid content; reserve 200 for successful resources.

findings.summary: The root html element has no lang attribute.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence reports lang:null and evaluate shows <html> with no attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the correct BCP 47 language tag on <html> and use logical CSS properties when content and layout are restored.
